assumptions: Exploratory latent class analysis of one governed county snapshot, dispatched by the user on 2026-10-17 for story 119.
Estimand A uses HUMAN_STATUS, SCAPULARIS_STATUS, PACIFICUS_STATUS, and BURGDORFERI_STATUS. Estimand B omits HUMAN_STATUS.
Class counts 2 through 6 are selected by the stability and BIC rule in docs/eda/119-analysis-spec.md before any follow-up list is inspected.
No records and Unknown remain categories. The human blank is no_county_linked_record and is not recoded.
limitations: Classes describe surveillance situations. They are not disease risk, incidence, or a production score.
The October catalog and docs/eda/prod-exhaustive-eda.md already published the surveillance cross-tab, so this run is exploratory relative to that description.
County rows are state-dependent. Fit statistics are descriptive summaries, not independent-sample tests.
API serving and production publication are outside story 119.
